configuration.title: Archeology Doc
config.path.description: Path to the `adoc` binary. Empty: it is looked up in PATH and ~/.cargo/bin. Only read from user settings, never from workspace settings.
config.decorations.description: Mark the lines cited as evidence of findings in the editor.
config.checkToolsOnStartup.description: On startup, check that adoc, git, Node and VitePress are installed and offer to install whatever is missing.
config.downloadUrl.description: https URL of the /download folder adoc is installed from. Empty: https://archeology-doc.com/download.
config.language.auto: Same as the VS Code display language (Spanish if it starts with "es", otherwise English).
config.language.description: Language of the extension UI (notifications, views, status bar, dashboard) and of the `adoc` CLI messages it runs (`ADOC_LANG`). Command and view titles follow the VS Code display language.
